title: Componentwise normalization: local structure and birational recognition
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], and write $
u_X:X^
u	o X$ for the componentwise normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. (1) $X^
u$ is normal [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and $
u_X$ is integral and surjective [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. It induces a bijection of generic points of irreducible components; for each such point $\eta\in X$, the fibre $X^
u	imes_X\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$ is canonically $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$ over $\kappa(\eta)$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-fibre-product]. (2) For every open subscheme $U\subseteq X$, the restriction $(X^
u)	imes_X U	o U$ is canonically its componentwise normalization; if $U$ is normal this restriction is an isomorphism. (3) Let $Z$ be a normal locally Noetherian scheme and $f:Z	o X$ an integral morphism. Suppose $f$ induces a bijection between the generic points of irreducible components, and for every generic point $\xi\in Z$ with image $\eta$ the induced residue-field map $\kappa(\eta)	o\kappa(\xi)$ is an isomorphism. Then there is a unique isomorphism $Z\cong X^
u$ over $X$. The empty scheme and nonreduced $X$ are allowed.

source.place: Tags 035Q (lemma-normalization-normal), parts (1)--(3), including the footnote allowing birationality on reductions; 035K (lemma-normalization-localization); 0H7D (lemma-normalization-trivial). Generic fibre statement from the construction in equation-generic-points and Tag 035P (lemma-description-normalization). Recognition in (3) is 035Q(3) followed by 0H7D on Z.
